POWER MECHANICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to computer aided drawing.

2. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after electronic systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for electronic systems.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Careers in Power Mechanics.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

16. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Four - stroke diesel engines 4.2 Two -stroke Diesel engines 4.3 Diesel fuel syst and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
